cards.card_text: For lack of anything else, she will secretly eat the afterbirth and the children she bears.
cards.verse_text: The most gentle and refined woman among you, so gentle and refined she would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground, will begrudge the husband she embraces and her son and daughter the afterbirth that comes from between her legs and the children she bears, because she will secretly eat them for lack of anything else in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within your gates.
cards.snippet: …will begrudge the husband she embraces and her son and daughter the afterbirth that comes from between her legs and the children she bears, because…
